sources.snippet: Intelligent Email & SMS Spam Detection using Machine Learning SpamShield AI is a professional Machine Learning web application that detects whether an Email or SMS message is Spam or Safe (Not Spam). The application is built using Python, Streamlit, Scikit-Learn, NLTK, and TF-IDF Vectorization, providing fast and accurate predictions with an interactive user interface.
